checks.evidence: Date line printed on the scanned cover (leaf 0): "A FAWCETTE TECHNICAL PUBLICATION, MARCH 1996 VOL. 6, NO. 3". The contents page of the same scan (leaf 4) repeats the image with the same date line. VB4-era content inside. Checked by eye on the page images, not from the catalog title.

The archive item has no license or rights metadata. The issue reads "all rights reserved". The uploader is an individual, not the publisher.

checks.claim: Access method involved no account, payment, watermark removal or CAPTCHA.
checks.evidence: Anonymous public HTTPS download; response headers recorded in evidence/source.json access block. No watermark present.
Proposed credit in evidence/rights.json; final wording depends on the rights route.
